name: smwsprites-silius-shooter-v1
title: Silius Shooter v1.0
description:
This is a fairly simple sprite. It will rotate (clockwise or counterclockwise depending on its direction) and periodically shoot bullets along its rotation. The shooter itself can't interact with the player. Features easy GFX remapping.

Requested for the Strongest Sprite Workshop 2020 by Daizo Dee Von
